Operating RoEV stood at 18.7% and MCEV reached ₹28,871 Cr with 194% solvency.

Background: Search proceedings were conducted at AMLI's 90-C premises alleging that the company has availed excess/ineligible ITC with respect to one of marketing vendor i.e. M/s Prefect Marketing during FY 2020-21 to FY 2024-25 owing to non provison of service to AMLI. Subsequently, on 7 August 2026, the GST department, Haryana issued Show Cause Notice u/s 74 with base tax demand of INR 13.34 Crs [apart from interest of INR 8.25 Crs and penalty of INR 12.85 Crs] . Status: 1. The company has filed its detailed response on 7 October 2026. 2. Communication from tax department is awaited.

Background: The Income Tax Department in AY 2017-18 has filed an appeal before the Delhi High Court against the favourable decision of ITAT in AY 2017-18 on matters comprising of Bonus to policyholders, FFA (Funds for Future Appropriation), Taxation of shareholder income at normal rates and disallowance u/s 14A (disallowance of expense incurred for earning exempt income). Similar to AY 2010-11, the Delhi High Court has admitted Bonus and FFA for further hearing and rejected other matters. Tax Impact of the admitted matter is ~ INR 128 Crs. Status: 1. Company received favourable order from ITAT & Income Tax Department has filed an appeal before Hon'ble High Court. 2. Delhi High Court has admitted the matter of Bonus and FFA for further deliberation on hearing dated 12 October 2026. 3. Next date of hearing would be notified.

entities.name: Max Life Pension Fund Management Limited

operating_notes.text: WTW actuarial report confirmed Axis Max Life Insurance EV of ₹28,870.5 Cr and FY26 VNB of ₹2,647.1 Cr.
Axis Max Life Assets Under Management reached ₹1,89,795 Cr as of March 31, 2026, up 8% YoY.
FY26 individual new business sum assured reached ₹5,43,210 Cr, up 42% YoY.
Axis Max Life individual adjusted first-year premium reached ₹9,885 Cr in FY26, growing 19% YoY.
Axis Max Life allotted 2.51 cr equity shares to Axis Bank at ₹151.90 per share, reducing MFSL's shareholding to ~80.01%.
Axis Max Life Insurance paid ₹532.92 Cr towards interest and redemption of 4,960 unsecured subordinated NCDs (ISIN INE511N08016) on call option exercise.
Material subsidiary Axis Max Life Insurance received GST SCNs proposing aggregate demand of ~₹35.29 Cr (tax, interest, and penalty) for FY21 to FY25.
Axis Bank infused INR 381 crore equity in Axis Max Life during Q1FY27, increasing its stake to 19.99%
Policyholder operating expense as % of GWP improved by 185 bps YoY to 16% despite healthy business growth
AUM crossed ₹2 lakh crore milestone, closing at ₹2.03 lakh crore at end-June 2026, up 11% YoY

On 24 August 2026, SEBI disposed of proceedings against Noticees 1 to 12 (including MFSL and Axis Max Life) under the Oct 2024 SCN without penalty; settlement applications for 13 directors remain pending.
Axis Max Life Insurance issued ₹686 Cr of 10-year subordinated NCDs on 28 September 2026 with a 5-year call option.
Axis Max Life H1 FY27 Individual Adjusted First Year Premium grew 12% to ₹4,368 Cr with AUM reaching ₹2.06 lakh Cr.
H1 FY’27 VNB at ₹1,180 Cr grew by 21% YoY and NBM at 25.4%.

timeline.summary: Max Financial Services Limited reported Q3FY25 results with revenue of ₹8,923 Cr and PAT of ₹69.81 Cr.
Max Financial Services Limited, via **Siddhi Suneja**, cancels the Q4 FY26 earnings call originally scheduled for May 13, 2026, at 9:00 AM (IST).
Max Financial Services announced shareholder approval via postal ballot for raising up to ₹1,600 Cr and preferential allotment of AMLI shares to Axis Bank for ₹389 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹10,801.94 Cr (-12.7% YoY)
Willis Towers Watson issued independent actuarial opinion confirming Axis Max Life's EV at ₹28,870.5 Cr and VNB at ₹2,647.1 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Axis Max Life FY26 VNB grew 26% to ₹2,647 Cr as NBM rose 120 bps to 25.2% on ₹10,502 Cr total APE.
Axis Max Life reported FY26 individual adjusted first-year premium growth of 19% to ₹9,885 Cr and a 26% increase in VNB to ₹2,647 Cr.
Axis Max Life allotted 2.51 cr equity shares to Axis Bank for ₹381 cr, reducing MFSL's stake in the material subsidiary to ~80.01%.
Max Financial Services Limited announced its 38th AGM to be held on August 19, 2026, via VC/OAVM.
Material subsidiary Axis Max Life redeemed 4,960 subordinated NCDs paying ₹532.92 Cr interest and principal.
Axis Max Life Insurance Limited redeemed ₹496 Cr subordinated NCDs (ISIN INE511N08016) and paid ₹37.2 Cr interest on call option exercise on July 31, 2026.
Material subsidiary Axis Max Life received GST SCNs proposing aggregate demand of ₹35.29 Cr for FY21-FY25.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹14,969.51 Cr (+16.8% YoY), net profit ₹118.29 Cr (+36.8% YoY).
Max Financial Services reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹14,977 Cr (+17% YoY) and net profit of ₹118 Cr, driven by Axis Max Life Insurance's performance.
Max Financial Services Limited’s 38th AGM (August 19, 2026) passed all resolutions with requisite majority; Scrutinizer Kapil Dev Taneja (FCS No. 4019) reported voting results.
Max Financial Services Q1FY27 VNB margin expanded to 23.2% from 20.3% YoY, driven by protection mix and yield curve benefits.
SEBI issued a final order disposing of the October 2024 Show Cause Notice against Max Financial and Axis Max Life without directions or penalties.
Material subsidiary Axis Max Life Insurance allotted ₹686 Cr of 10-year subordinated NCDs on private placement.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹11,601.09 Cr (+18.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹79.92 Cr (+1839.8% YoY).
Axis Max Life reported H1 FY27 VNB of ₹1,180 Cr (+21% YoY) with a margin expansion of 210 bps to 25.4%.
Max Financial Services reported H1FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹219 Cr and VNB of ₹1,180 Cr, up 21% YoY.
